detail.longDescription: One 404 was enough to steal an MCP client's OAuth secret. In the MCP Python SDK before 1.30.0 and 2.2.0, a malicious server could fail the first discovery step, push the client onto an older fallback that skipped the issuer check, and collect its client secret, authorization code and PKCE verifier. The login page is genuine. Upgrade, and rotate secrets if exposed. https:// cycode.com/blog/mcp-python-sdk -oauth-account-takeover/ # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents # Python
